rules.title: Community Rules
rules.subtitle: These rules help keep CyberStars a positive learning environment for everyone.

items.title: Be respectful
items.desc: Treat everyone with kindness. No harassment, bullying, hate speech, or personal attacks.

items.title: Keep it appropriate
items.desc: No spam, advertising in the forum, or anywhere on the platform.

items.title: No exploiting bugs
items.desc: If you find a bug or exploit, report it via Support instead of abusing it for badges or other gains.

items.title: Privacy
items.desc: Do not share personal information (email, phone number, home address, workplace) — your own or anyone else's — in the forum or in any public part of the platform.
